text:
priya: Heads up — need to finalize enterprise evidence retention phasing and launch criteria for SOC2 customers. High-level items: audit search SLA, BYOK/KMS handshake, legal-hold snapshots, and archival tiers. Can we align today? @kevin @maria @sam
kevin: Got it. I sketched a phased rollout: Phase 1 = SOC2 pilot (internal), 30d hot index + 365d warm. Phase 2 = BYOK handshake + export APIs. Phase 3 = per-tenant retention SLAs + legal-hold + long-term archive. Quick Q: what's acceptable search SLA for full-window queries?
maria: For SOC2 we need chain-of-custody and tamper-evident evidence. KMS integration must support key rotation and produce attestation for audits. Also need threat model sign-off before pilot.
sam: Search latency depends on sharding + cache. For 30d hot I can promise P95 <= 300ms. For 31-365d warm we can aim P95 <= 2-4s if we warm caches; cold object retrieval (S3) will be async. Is 4s acceptable for pilot?
nate: Customer asks keep coming: a few want 7y retention and tenant-controlled keys. Need explicit tradeoffs (cost, egress, SLA). Also we should prepare enterprise contract language.
priya: Proposed launch (must-haves): 1) SOC2 pilot pass, 2) BYOK handshake docs + API, 3) evidence export (CSV/NDJSON), 4) baseline search SLA metrics for hot/warm windows, 5) legal-hold snapshot workflow. Nice-to-have: per-tenant UI for retention and long-term archival export. Thoughts?
kevin: Agree. Also add: rollback plan + feature-flagged fallback for degraded search, plus migration plan for existing customers' logs to new index layout.
maria: I'll draft acceptance criteria for tamper-evidence: hashed snapshots, signed manifests, and retention-proof logs. We can reuse the internal timestamping service for signatures.
sam: I'll open engineering tickets. Quick retention matrix sketch: 
```
hot: 0-30d -> index=hot-shard, search=P95<=300ms
warm: 31-365d -> store=columnar/warm index, search=P95<=4s
cold: >365d -> S3 archive (NDJSON), retrieval SLA=24h
```
ops-bot: JIRA INF-12234 created: "enterprise-retention-phased-rollout" assigned to sam, kevin, maria. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-12234
priya: :thumbsup: Action items: sam — create eng tickets + rough estimates; kevin — migration plan + fallback design; maria — audit acceptance criteria + BYOK rotation doc; nate — customer comms + contract language. Target SOC2 pilot by 2025-02-15. Any objections?
nate: Works for me. I'll line up pilot customers and draft contract bullets.
kevin: Timeline note — need ~6 weeks to implement hot/warm indexing and basic BYOK handshake. I'll push a draft timeline tomorrow.
priya: Thanks everyone. Add blockers to INF-12234 and we'll triage in next PM sync. End of thread.
